method: 2010–2014 only unions of essentially whole DeSO; 2015 onward contemporaneous population-grid intersection weights. Each reference year uses boundaries of its electoral edition (2010, 2014, 2018, 2022; 2025 uses 2026 boundaries). Current map observations are reused exactly. No population before 2010. Territorial links and breaks inherited from the corresponding election-edition chain. No interpolation of missing observations. 2024 switches to DeSO 2025; 2025 introduces CKM.
